construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation constructed in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Version 1 object: synthetic=true, explicit timezone as_of, SYN- policyholder_ref, items, events; optional half_life_days (default 30) and limit (default 10). Unknown fields rejected recursively.
shared_schema.item: Unique SYN- id, entity (policy, claim, underwriting_submission), source {format,payload}. All source adapters feed one normalization and validation layer.
shared_schema.formats: ACORD-style JSON wraps fields under ACORD. Simple XML uses an ACORD root with scalar children (policy/claim). Underwriting factor lists use JSON. Claim-form text uses strict key: value lines; no arbitrary narrative.
shared_schema.attributes: All entities require line=auto/property. Policy: positive coverage_amount. Claim: nonnegative loss_amount, timezone loss_date not after as_of, boolean documents_complete. Submission: disclosed allowed numeric factors.
shared_schema.event: Unique SYN- id, known item_id, browse/purchase action, timezone at not after as_of; purchase only for policy.
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, synthetic, cold_start, ranked recommendations with normalized attributes/scores/reasons, separate complete claim_handling, safeguards. Error output: status=error and generic message; exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: One functionality: source decoding -> shared schema validation -> recency-weighted discovery -> JSON response. Claims administrative routing is a behavior-independent guardrail, not a downstream personalized decision stage.

behavior.scoring: Sum action_weight * 2^(-age_days/half_life_days) per item plus 0.2 times same-entity interest sum; browse=1, purchase=3. Explicit as_of makes ranking deterministic.
behavior.cold_start: No effective event weight: equal zero scores and stable id ordering. All ties use id ascending.
behavior.fair_claim_handling: Documents complete -> ready_for_human_review; incomplete -> request_information, each with reason. Every claim appears in separate handling output even when discovery limit excludes it. Rank never decides eligibility, payments, denial or processing priority.
behavior.minimization: Only synthetic holder reference accepted. Names, VINs, addresses and arbitrary free text rejected, never echoed in errors. Invented policyholder, fabricated VIN/address fixtures in tests demonstrate rejection of unnecessary identifying fields.
behavior.underwriting: Only coverage_amount, property_age_years, vehicle_age_years accepted. Each factor requires disclosed=true and appears in recommendation attributes. Factors do not affect discovery scoring.
behavior.fixtures: All fixtures clearly synthetic. Claim loss amounts and dates also generated deterministically using seed 156 in tests.
